name: alwrity
description: An AI-first digital marketing platform providing capabilities for content strategy and planning, multimodal content generation, publishing, analytics, AI-driven SEO, and social account management.

inputs.name: content_strategy_parameters
inputs.description: Parameters defining goals, target audience, keywords, and campaign objectives for AI-driven content strategy and planning.

inputs.name: content_requests
inputs.description: Requests specifying type (text, image, video), theme, style, and length for multimodal content generation.

inputs.name: social_account_credentials
inputs.description: Authentication and connection details for managing and connecting social media accounts.

inputs.name: published_content_data
inputs.description: Content metadata and status updates for publication workflows and scheduling.

inputs.name: analytics_query_parameters
inputs.description: Parameters defining metrics, date ranges, channels, and reports for marketing analytics and insights.

inputs.name: seo_keywords_and_content
inputs.description: SEO keywords, competitor data, and content inputs for AI-powered SEO optimization.

outputs.name: content_strategy_plan
outputs.description: A structured content strategy outlining topics, posting schedule, and channel recommendations.

outputs.name: generated_content
outputs.description: AI-generated content including text, images, videos, and multimedia assets.

outputs.name: publish_status
outputs.description: Status updates and confirmations regarding content publishing on social or digital channels.

outputs.name: analytics_reports
outputs.description: Insights, performance metrics, and analytic reports related to marketing campaigns and content effectiveness.

outputs.name: seo_recommendations
outputs.description: AI-driven SEO suggestions and optimizations to improve search engine rankings.

outputs.name: social_account_management_status
outputs.description: Feedback and status information about connections and management of social media accounts.

steps: Define marketing goals and target audience in content strategy parameters.
Use AI modules to generate a content strategy plan based on input parameters.
Request multimodal content generation from AI using specified themes and formats.
Manage and connect social media accounts via the platform for content publishing.
Publish generated content to selected digital and social channels.
Collect and analyze marketing and campaign data to produce analytics reports.
Apply AI-driven SEO optimization suggestions to published or planned content.
Monitor social account statuses and manage publishing schedules accordingly.
use_cases: Automated digital marketing strategy development for businesses and agencies.
Creating diverse marketing materials such as blog posts, social media posts, videos, and images using AI.
Scheduling and managing publishing across multiple social media platforms.
Tracking campaign performance and generating actionable marketing analytics reports.
Implementing AI-powered SEO improvements to enhance online content visibility.
Centralized management of multiple social media accounts and campaigns.
patterns: AI-enhanced SEO keyword and content optimization

prompt_templates.name: content_strategy
prompt_templates.template: Create a content strategy plan targeting {target_audience} with a focus on {primary_goals} using keywords {keywords_list}.

prompt_templates.name: generate_multimodal_content
prompt_templates.template: Generate a {content_type} about {topic} with a {style} style and length of {length}.

prompt_templates.name: publish_content
prompt_templates.template: Publish the content titled '{content_title}' to {social_platforms} on {scheduled_date}.

prompt_templates.name: request_analytics_report
prompt_templates.template: Provide analytics report for campaigns between {start_date} and {end_date} focusing on {metrics}.

prompt_templates.name: seo_optimization
prompt_templates.template: Suggest SEO improvements for the content about {topic} focusing on keywords {keywords_list}.

prompt_templates.name: connect_social_account
prompt_templates.template: Connect and authenticate social media account for platform {platform_name} with credentials {credentials}.
